title: Undeployed Virtual Thread verticles cause memory leaks and/or never stop

comments.body: Do you have reproducers for this ? I suspect we indeed should scan the task queue to interrupt the pending threads there

I can make some, although will be quite tedious due to encapsulation to query the remaining threads.

But the basic logic itself is clear, there are no interrupts. I tried in my own branch to interrupt after the close future runs, usually it is OK, but sometimes creates odd race conditions or for example triggers `.recover` future monad. In other cases interrupting before close future also allows graceful exit, but also has issues. 

Optimally if we could short circuit TaskQueue would be optimal, or completely jump the `await`

I would appreciate a reproducer
